headline: DeepSeek's v4.1 Flash takes rank one for the first time, with 15.7% of tokens
summary: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 has taken the top spot for the first time, and its 15.7% share is also an all-time high. DeepSeek as a provider now holds 35.5% of tokens, and the top two providers together hold 46.2%.
highlights: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 jumped six places to No. 1 with 15.7% of tokens, a new all-time share high.
DeepSeek overall sits at 35.5%, up 3.4% over the day.
The top two providers, DeepSeek and Zhipu AI, together hold 46.2%.
New entrants this round: openai/gpt-6-sol-20260922 at No. 42, mistralai/mistral-nemo at No. 46, and deepseek/deepseek-v3.2-20251201 at No. 49.
